parameters.description:
Time series. If 2d, individual series are in columns. x must contain 2
complete cycles.
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: Type of seasonal component. The abbreviations "add" and "mul" are accepted.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description:
The filter coefficients for filtering out the seasonal component.
The concrete moving average method used in filtering is determined by
two_sided.
parameters.name: filt

parameters.description:
Period of the series (eg, 1 for annual, 4 for quarterly, etc). Must be
used if x is not a pandas object or if the index of x does not have a
frequency. Overrides default periodicity of x if x is a pandas object
with a timeseries index.
parameters.name: period

parameters.description:
The moving average method used in filtering.
If True (default), a centered moving average is computed using the
filt. If False, the filter coefficients are for past values only.
parameters.name: two_sided

parameters.description:
If set to > 0, the trend resulting from the convolution is
linear least-squares extrapolated on both ends (or the single one
if two_sided is False) considering this many (+1) closest points.
If set to 'period', use `period` closest points. Setting this parameter
results in no NaN values in trend or resid components. The default is 0.

.. deprecated: 0.14
    `extrapolate_trend="freq"` is deprecated and will be removed,
    use `extrapolate_trend=period` instead.
parameters.name: extrapolate_trend

returns.description: An object with seasonal, trend, and resid attributes.

signature: seasonal_decompose(x, model='additive', filt=None, period=None, two_sided=True, extrapolate_trend=0)
